scope: Read-only review of the native Scope Unit Declaration instance-context binding in the moved formal-contract graph code. It covers bounded source provenance and focused compatibility only; it is not a rendered-graph, Current publication, or full-runtime conformance result.

checks.name: native_provenance_binding
checks.evidence: The former hard-coded instance-selector allowlist is replaced with exact parsed Scope Unit//Name or Project//Name evidence from Requirement/Form Scope Unit Declaration carriers. The binding records the selected declaration source and binds only to an already-declared generic Scope Unit or Project target.

checks.name: bounded_non_scope_compatibility
checks.evidence: The compatibility restoration is limited to the three pre-existing non-Scope contexts: Projection//PROJECT_SCOPE_UNIT_GRAPH, NamedSelection//ExtensionSources, and PROJECTSTRUCTURE//CAPRMEDIO. It retains their existing binding name and adds bounded_named_contract_context provenance; no Scope Unit or Project hard-coded selector is restored.

checks.name: no_instance_model_ownership_or_tree_narrowing
checks.evidence: The binding attaches shared RMED evidence to the generic primary-node target only. Instance selectors are not catalog declarations and Scope Unit Declaration carriers are excluded from narrowing-tree declaration inputs.

checks.name: negative_proof_cases
checks.evidence: Direct focused checks confirm a duplicate Scope Unit Declaration proof leaves the duplicate proof records and consumer unbound; a Scope Unit Declaration for Actor remains unbound even when generic Actor is declared; and a missing generic Scope Unit target cannot bind.

checks.name: current_api_status_boundary
checks.evidence: The existing read_current_carriers API excludes Draft and Archived Atom carriers before compose_contract_graph receives candidates. The reviewed binding adds no separate lifecycle filter or wider validator.

checks.name: focused_regression_suite
checks.evidence: 11 tests passed, including the source-proven Scope Unit/Project positive binding and existing contract-graph callers.
